source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of metals, metallurgy and alloys (PDF 218-220).

blocks.text: Metals sakht, mazboot (rigid) maddey hain jo hararat aur bijli ke achhe conductors hain. Yeh malleable (chadar ban jane wale) aur ductile (taar ban jane wale) hain, is liye toote baghair chadaron mein bel ya taron mein khainche ja sakte hain. Steel apni mazbooti ki wajah se pulon aur imaraton mein, aluminium halka hone ki wajah se hawai jahazon ke dhanchon mein, aur copper bijli ka bohat achha conductor hone ki wajah se bijli ki taron mein use hota hai.

Metals zameen ki parat (crust) mein milti hain. Kam reactive metals jaise sona aur platinum azad (metallic) halat mein milti hain. Zyada reactive metals jaise sodium, aluminium, loha aur copper mili hui (combined) halat mein ores ki shakal mein milti hain; maslan haematite, Fe2O3, lohe ki ore hai. Ores khalis compounds nahi balke matloob metal compound, napaki aur mitti jaise maddon ka amezah hain jinhein gangue kehte hain.

blocks.title: Metallurgy
blocks.text: Metallurgy metals ko un ki ores se nikalne aur behtar istemal ke liye khalis banane ka ilm hai. Metal ki reactivity aur nau'iyat nikalne ka tareeqa tay karti hai.

items: Mining (kaan kani): metal ki ore zameen se khod kar nikali jati hai (Figure 31.2 lohe ki kaan aur haematite ka tukra dikhati hai).
Ore concentration: ore ko jitna mumkin ho napaki se saaf kiya jata hai.
Concentrated ore ko roasting ya calcination se metal oxide mein badalna.
Metal oxide ko metal mein reduce karna.

blocks.text: Roasting sulphide ore ko hawa ki zyada miqdar mein garam karna hai: 2ZnS(s) + 3O2(g) -> 2ZnO(s) + 2SO2(g). Calcination metal carbonate ore ko kam ya baghair hawa ke garam kar ke oxide mein badalna hai: ZnCO3(s) -> ZnO(s) + CO2(g).

Metal oxide ka reduction sab se ahem qadam hai. Kam reactive metals (reactivity series mein carbon se neeche) ke liye carbon reducing agent ke taur par use hota hai. Carbon pehle carbon monoxide banta hai, jo phir metal oxide se oxygen hata kar azad metal chhor deta hai. Lohe ki ore ke liye: C + 1/2 O2 -> CO, phir Fe2O3 + 3CO -> 2Fe + 3CO2.

Yeh tareeqa carbon se zyada reactive metals ke liye kaam nahi karta, kyunke carbon un ke oxides reduce nahi kar sakta. Aisi metals (maslan Na, K aur Al) ke liye electrolysis ka tareeqa use hota hai: metal compound pighla kar us mein bijli guzari jati hai, jis ke liye bohat tawanai chahiye. Musbat metal ions manfi electrode (cathode) ki taraf jate hain, jahan electrons le kar metal bante hain. Copper jaisi kam reactive metals ko bohat khalis banane ke liye bhi electrolysis use hoti hai.

Refining: reduction ke baad milne wali metal aam taur par kafi khalis hoti hai, lekin kuch kaamon ke liye bohat khalis metal chahiye; maslan bijli ki wiring ke liye copper 99.99% khalis hona chahiye. Metal thermal, kimiyai ya electrochemical tareeqon se saaf ki ja sakti hai. Alloying do ya zyada metals, ya metal aur non-metal, ko mila kar yaksan (homogeneous) amezah banana hai. Is se metal ki microstructure badalti aur mazbooti, zang se bachao (corrosion resistance), aur electrical ya magnetic khasiyatein behtar hoti hain.

blocks.alt: Chhe qadam oopar se neeche teeron se jure: i. Mining (ore nikali jati, maslan Fe2O3), ii. Concentration (napaki door), iii. Roasting / calcination (ZnCO3 -> ZnO + CO2), iv. Reduction (Fe2O3 + 3CO -> 2Fe + 3CO2), v. Refining (taron ke liye Cu 99.99% khalis), vi. Alloying (maslan brass, bronze, steel).

blocks.prompt: Sodium electrolysis se kyun nikala jata hai, carbon se reduction se kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: Sodium carbon se zyada reactive hai, is liye carbon is ke compounds reduce nahi kar sakta; pighle compound ki electrolysis chahiye.

blocks.prompt: Roasting calcination se kaise mukhtalif hai?
blocks.explanation: Roasting sulphide ore ko zyada hawa mein garam karti hai (SO2 banti); calcination carbonate ore ko kam ya baghair hawa ke garam karti hai (CO2 banti).

items: Qadam: mining, concentration, roasting ya calcination, reduction, refining, alloying.
Carbon se neeche: CO se reduce; oopar (Na, K, Al): electrolysis.
Alloys (brass, bronze, steel, duralumin) khasiyatein behtar karte.
